guidance.anti_pattern: Bus-state sampling: TX counter increment gated by bus readback (e.g., if (~bus_rx) low_cnt <= low_cnt + 1). The bus value depends on pull-up rise time, loading, and sync latency — making timing non-deterministic.
guidance.correct_pattern: Time-based counting: counter increments unconditionally during tx_data_enable. Switch from low phase to high phase when low_cnt reaches the target count, not when the bus state changes. Example: if (low_cnt < TARGET) low_cnt <= low_cnt + 1; else high_cnt <= high_cnt + 1;
